scope: P10 pending-queue shuffle and off/one/all repeat modes.
implemented: Shuffle requires the current server revision and changes only pending tracks while preserving every stable queue identity.
Repeat supports off, current-track and whole-queue modes and is broadcast in channel state.
Only naturally completed tracks are requeued; explicit skip, stop and playback failures are excluded.
The web/desktop voice panel exposes accessible shuffle and repeat controls and refreshes authoritative server state after mutations.
remaining: Two-client acceptance must verify synchronized shuffle order and repeat behavior with real YouTube audio in an encrypted voice room.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
